notes: New: Progress over the year - your six stats plotted month by month across 12 months, each point re-read from the sessions that preceded it
New: a year grid showing every day you trained, one square per day, at a glance
New: Volume and recovery - weekly sets for the last 12 weeks, a deload read taken from your own logged effort, and days since each muscle group was last trained
New: set a target for any lift. Progress is always shown; a time estimate only appears when your own logged rate supports it
New: repeat your last session with one tap from the Log tab, and copy any past session in your notes format
New: a dated backup is written once a day alongside the on-device copy, keeping the last five
Fix: the dashboard could overrun the screen sideways on a phone, clipping text at the edge. The page is now locked to the screen width
